    logger.info("Instalando dependencias declaradas en %s", path.name)
    subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "-r", str(path)],
        check=True,
    )


def download_and_verify(url: str, expected_sha256: str, dest: Path) -> None:
    if not url.startswith("https://"):
        raise ValueError("Solo se permiten descargas por HTTPS")
    logger.info("Descargando paquete extra...")
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) as resp, dest.open("wb") as fh:
            while chunk := resp.read(CHUNK_SIZE):
                digest.update(chunk)
                fh.write(chunk)
    except urllib.error.URLError as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Fallo la descarga del paquete extra: {exc.reason}") from exc
    actual = digest.hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(actual, expected_sha256.lower()):
        dest.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        raise RuntimeError("Verificación de integridad fallida: el hash SHA-256 no coincide")
    logger.info("Integridad verificada (SHA-256 coincide)")

import hashlib
import hmac
import logging
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(levelname)s: %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("scenario")

BASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REQUIREMENTS_FILE = BASE_DIR / "requirements.txt"

# --- Paquete extra: Pillow (procesamiento de imágenes) ---------------------
# URL fija del wheel oficial publicado en PyPI. Para actualizarla:

)
PILLOW_WHEEL_SHA256 = "REEMPLAZAR_CON_SHA256_OFICIAL"

ALLOWED_DOWNLOAD_HOSTS = {"files.pythonhosted.org", "pypi.org"}
DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30
CHUNK_SIZE = 64 * 1024


def _check_requirements_pinned(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    """Devuelve las líneas de dependencias y exige versión fijada (==)."""
    if not path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Archivo de requerimientos no encontrado: {path}")
    requirements = []
    for lineno, raw in enumerate(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines(), start=1):

        if not line or line.startswith("#"):

        if "==" not in line:

    pinned = _check_requirements_pinned(path)

    subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "-r", str(path)],
        check=True,
    )


def _validate_download_url(url: str) -> None:
    parsed = urlparse(url)
    if parsed.scheme != "https":
        raise ValueError("Solo se permiten descargas por HTTPS")
    if parsed.hostname not in ALLOWED_DOWNLOAD_HOSTS:

        )

    logger.info("Descargando %s", url.rsplit("/", 1)[-1])
